fire_sequence: ROTATION fire. Surveyed evidence/phase0/kpis/ for the strongest never-before-ledger-attacked STANDING claim (cross-checked against 26 prior amphora-molecule-property ledger lines, none of which name polyuniverse-epoxy-tg-conformal-coverage-and-applicability-domain-kpi.v1.json). That KPI's headline (marginal split-conformal coverage 0.9049 >= 0.90 target on n=10,279 scaffold-safe held-out test polymers, 10/10 deterministic gates passed, hostile-null and AD-quintile positive controls already built in) is one of the module's most statistically rigorous artifacts. Independently re-derived its target variable ('Tg (K)') straight from the pinned raw CSV (dataset_fixture_sha256 9f1f5c59..., byte-verified) and found it is thermodynamically inadmissible taken literally as Kelvin (1 row Tg<0K; 0/1,000,000 rows reach 300K room temperature for a coating meant to be a rigid solid there). Investigating further surfaced that this EXACT defect was already discovered and honestly disclosed by a sibling receipt in this module (polyuniverse-epoxy-tg-external-validation-5-canonical-epoxy-amines-kpi.v1.json / docs/mission.md 'CRITICAL HONEST FINDING -- units disclosure': the raw column is degC, not K; a Celsius delta equals a Kelvin delta so RMSE/MAE/coverage-WIDTH magnitudes are unaffected, only the absolute-value unit LABEL was wrong). The live falsifiable question this fire actually tests is narrower and novel: has that already-known correction been PROPAGATED to every sibling KPI that shares the same raw-CSV provenance, per this module's own supersede-never-rewrite / RETRACTION-INDEX discipline -- the same propagation-completeness pattern precedent W3 (2026-08-02, dielectric-retraction propagation) established and REFUTED for a different label defect.

rule_1_absolute_zero.statement: T[K] >= 0 always, by definition of the Kelvin scale (no exception, no domain assumption required)

rule_2_room_temperature_sanity.statement: A cured epoxy-amine MARINE COATING network is designed to be a rigid glassy solid at ambient service temperature; essentially all real cured epoxy-amine Tg values in the literature this module already cites (May 1988 Ch.6; this module's own OpenPoly experimental Tg corpus, range [146,589] K) sit at or above ~300 K

rule_3_below_lowest_known_polymer_Tg.statement: PDMS (polydimethylsiloxane), one of the most flexible common polymers known, has Tg ~146-150 K (Mark, J.E. ed. 2007, Physical Properties of Polymers Handbook, 2nd ed., Springer, Ch.19 Table 19.1) -- among the lowest Tg of any widely-characterized polymer. A rigid, aromatic, densely-crosslinked epoxy-amine thermoset network should not read BELOW this floor.
